what: Mode-first List Extractor with 3 modes: multi-block select, full-page (+load-more), pagination (limit/all + collection).
constraints: No settings/cloud; Text/Image/Maps out of scope.
done_criteria: UI chooses mode first; Blocks supports multi-select until Done; Full-page and Pagination need no item picker (dominant list); pagination writes per-page datasets + collection; extension 0.5.0.
